⚖️ Institutional Prime Brokerage, Stock Loan & Reg SHO AI
1. ❌ Stock-Loan Bot Bridged to Hedge-Fund Short Books & Locate APIs
• Uploaded short-locate request CSV injects prompt to leak rival hedge-fund short squeeze triggers
Archegos-Scale Default & SEC Reg SHO Fine: Issues naked-short locate IDs or waives margin calls
2. 🔒 Hedge-Fund Crowded Short Book & TRS Exposure Physical Air-Gap
• Locate-quoting bots have zero access to other funds' short books or Total Return Swap (TRS) margins
Anti-Predatory Squeeze Wall: 100% blocks locate bots from reading restricted-budget
3. 📜 SEC Reg SHO Rule 203(b) Locate ID & FINRA 4210 Margin Lock
• AI quotes indicative borrow fees only; zero direct write to Hard-to-Borrow locate IDs or margin waivers
Best Fit: EquiLend NGT, FIS Global One, SEC Reg SHO Rule 203/204 & FINRA Rule 4210
4. 🛡️ Mandatory Floor: Deterministic Capability Broker (Prime Broker Gate)
• Blocks short-book reads (record-owner) + blocks naked locate overrides (untrusted-write)
Measured: P50 = 0.0248 ms in-memory | 706 Scenarios · 1,478 Pytest Assertions 100% Pass

• Gate 3 (Immutable Fund Admin & Custodian SSI List): fixed-business-output locks registry
